summary: Korro Bio filed an 8-K covering an exchange agreement with Venrock Healthcare Capital Partners and Q2 2026 results. Venrock surrendered 1,000,000 common shares for no consideration; Korro issued pre-funded warrants for 1,000,000 shares at $0.001 exercise price, no expiration. The exchange aimed to reduce share count and replace with warrants, likely for accounting or capital structure purposes. Post-exchange, Korro had 13,725,646 shares outstanding and 4,148,836 pre-funded warrants. The warrants carry a 9.99% beneficial ownership blocker. No board recommendation or advisors named. Watch for future warrant exercises and resulting dilution.
